text: Coffee with Rebecca. Her son Noah starts reception sometime next week and she's more nervous than he is. Her husband's away for work so she's doing the drop off alone. Remind me to text her that morning.

Lwazi has a second interview at the bank on 2 November 2026. He said the first round was mostly technical. His partner Amy is hoping he gets it so they can move closer to her parents. Wish him luck the day before.

Caught up with Oscar on the phone. His daughter Chloe graduates from Leeds in July 2027, first in the family to go to uni. He's already looking at hotels. He's also finally getting his knee looked at early December.

spans.text: first in the family to go to uni

text: Pooja got the job!! Starts at the hospital end of the month. Her mum cried apparently. Send congrats and maybe flowers.

Rohan and Deepa's twins sit their GCSEs over the summer. Deepa says Aidan is fine but his sister is really struggling with maths and won't let anyone help. Rohan wants a tutor. Should check in with Deepa in a couple of weeks.
Mateo is applying for the head of design role at his place, deadline 14 November. He's not sure he wants the management side. His wife Ilse thinks he should go for it. Ask him whether he sent it.

spans.text: applying for the head of design role
not sure he wants the management side
Ask him whether he sent it

text: Hugo's dog Biscuit had his op on Tuesday, all fine, cone of shame for ten days. Hugo also mentioned his brother Juan is moving back from Lisbon in March 2027.
Zeynep's little one, Kemal, lost his first tooth today and wrote the tooth fairy a letter. She's starting her MSc in January.
Pick up Abigail's birthday card, post office shuts at 1 on Saturday.

Talked to Antoine after five a side. His interview at the council got pushed to sometime next week because the panel lead is off sick. He's been prepping every night and sounds pretty wound up about it. His girlfriend Petra is a teacher at the same primary as Rebecca, small world.
Kalani's graduation was yesterday. Ask her how it went and if she got the photos back.

spans.text: Ask her how it went and if she got the photos back

text: Erin mentioned her dad retires on 30 November 2026 after 32 years on the buses. They're throwing him a party at the social club the weekend after. She said he'd love a decent fishing reel, the old one's falling apart.
Haruto has his driving test 9 January 2027. Third attempt. He hates roundabouts. Don't forget to text him good luck.

Jun called. Saanvi's starting secondary in September and they still haven't heard back about the appeal. She's anxious about not being with her friends. Jun's working from home most days now. Call him end of next week to see if there's news.

spans.text: anxious about not being with her friends

text: Long catch up with Katarzyna. She's applied for three jobs since the redundancy, one at Nowak & Brennan looked promising and they want to see her early March. Money's tight but she says she's okay. Her son Pedro got into the county rugby squad which has cheered everyone up. Her mum's moving in with them over the summer to help out. I said I'd send her the contact for the recruiter Zhang used. Need to actually do that tonight.

spans.text: got into the county rugby squad
send her the contact for the recruiter Zhang used

text: Krisztina and her husband are going to Budapest for Christmas to see his family. Back 3 January.
Amy's interview went well she thinks. They said they'd let her know by Friday. Lwazi is hosting her parents this weekend which he's dreading.
Noah's school play is on 11 December. Rebecca says he's a sheep. Buy tickets.
Spoke to Ahmed. His wife Saanvi is expecting, due early May. They're keeping it quiet until the 12 week scan next month. Ahmed is vegetarian now, keep in mind for dinner.
Luca's sister Chloe is doing her bar exams in February 2027 and has basically moved into the library. He's worried she's burning out. Must ask him how she's doing at some point next week.
Need to renew passport before end of the month. Also dentist on the 4th.
Oscar's wedding anniversary is 18 November, 25 years. He wants to surprise his wife with a weekend in Edinburgh. Remind me to ask him if he booked it.

spans.text: ask him if he booked it

text: Aidan got his A level results, AAB, he's off to Bristol for engineering. Rohan was beaming. Send Aidan a card.
Mateo's interview is now cancelled, they gave it to an internal candidate. He's gutted but already looking elsewhere. His eldest, Luca, starts nursery after half term.
Dinner at Petra's. She and Antoine have just got a cat called Pickle. Petra's training for the Brighton half in April, her first one. Antoine still hates running.

Zhang called about the job at the museum. He's on the shortlist, final round is sometime in the first week of December. He said his English presentation part is what scares him most. I should run through it with him beforehand.

spans.text: sometime in the first week of December
English presentation part is what scares him most

text: Deepa's mother had a fall last week and is in hospital. Deepa's back and forth every day. Drop round a lasagne.
Ilse said Mateo got the promotion after all! Starts as head of design in January. Also she's thinking of going back to uni part time.

spans.text: thinking of going back to uni part time

text: Grabbed lunch with Kemal and his brother Haruto. Kemal's been offered a place on the graduate scheme at Thomas Barros, starting September 2027. Haruto is still looking, he's had two interviews this month and hasn't heard back from either. He's trying to stay positive but you can tell it's getting to him. Kemal says their mum keeps asking Haruto about it at dinner which doesn't help. Message Haruto at the weekend, no job talk, just see if he wants to go climbing.
Juan's daughter's first day at big school went fine, apparently she cried, Juan cried, the teacher didn't.
Abigail mentioned she's allergic to nuts. Loves anything with matcha.

Saw Pedro and his partner Erin at the market. They're getting married in Portugal, sometime in June 2027, invites going out early in the new year. Erin's brother Noah is doing the speech. Pedro still at the garage.
Rebecca's mum turns 70 on 3 March 2027. Rebecca is doing a surprise lunch. I'm bringing the cake.
Lwazi didn't get the bank job. He's taking it okay, says the feedback was useful. Amy and him are looking at houses anyway. Call him this week.

Kalani says her son Jun has his grade 5 piano exam the week after next, he's been practising nonstop and is a bundle of nerves. Her husband is building the kid a treehouse which is apparently a disaster.
Krisztina's interview at the university is 25 November 2026 at 2pm. Ask her how it went that evening.
Note to self: finish job application for the Leeds role by Sunday night. Referees: Oscar and Katarzyna.

spans.text: finish job application for the Leeds role

text: Hugo and his wife are celebrating 10 years together next month. He keeps hinting she wants a proper espresso machine.
Aidan came by. Just finished his first term at Bristol, loves it, joined the climbing club. He's thinking of switching to physics. Rohan doesn't know yet.
Zeynep's interview at the agency was this morning. I forgot to text her luck. Ask her tonight how it went.

Erin's cousin Abigail is graduating from nursing in early March, Erin's driving up with her aunt. Erin herself has a job interview at Kowalski Johnson the same week, bad timing. She's pretty calm about it though.
Amy said Chloe (her niece) starts uni in Glasgow end of September. Her sister is in bits about it. Amy is helping move her up.
Weekend away with Petra and Antoine cancelled, Antoine's dad isn't well. Will rearrange for the spring.
Rohan's mother-in-law is visiting from Pune for most of December. He's slightly stressed, the spare room is still full of boxes.
Kemal's sister passed her medical finals!! She's officially Dr Kowalski as of today. Send her something nice.
Chat with Ahmed, he's leaving his job end of the month to go freelance. His boss tried to talk him out of it. His wife thinks it's the right move. Leaving drinks probably the Friday before.
Pooja's first week at the hospital done. She's on nights already and says she's exhausted. Her boyfriend Luca has been cooking for her. Check in with her sometime next week.
Noah (Rebecca's lad) had his first parents' evening, teacher says he's chatty but sweet. Rebecca was relieved.
Buy stamps, book car service, call council about the bin.
Talked to Jun about Saanvi. They won the appeal, she's going to Hillcrest with her friends in September 2027. Jun was over the moon.
Juan's interview at the airport is on 6 November 2026. He's nervous because it's his first interview in 15 years. He asked me to look over his CV first. Must do that by Wednesday.
Matcha latte place opened near Abigail's work, she'll be thrilled.

Spoke to Ilse about her sister Krisztina. Krisztina got the uni job and starts 1 February 2027, but has to move to Manchester for it. She's excited but sad about leaving her flat. Ilse says Krisztina's partner might follow over the summer if his transfer goes through. Remind me to ask Krisztina when her leaving do is.

spans.text: ask Krisztina when her leaving do is

text: Hugo's mum had her cataract operation this morning. All went well. Ask Hugo how she's recovering in a few days.
Lwazi says Amy's interview result came through and she got it! Starting 2 November 2026. They're celebrating Saturday at their place.
Kalani mentioned Jun passed his piano exam with merit. Also her husband finished the treehouse, finally.
Oscar's son Mateo is doing his mocks early January, then his driving test sometime in February. Oscar thinks he's not revising at all. Oscar himself is up for a promotion review end of the month.
Petra told me her nan died last weekend. Funeral is sometime next week, date not fixed yet. She sounded flat. Send her a card.
Haruto finally got a job offer! Junior analyst at a startup, starts the week after next. He said he nearly turned it down because of the commute. Kemal is buying the first round Friday.

Coffee with Zeynep, Kemal and Deepa. Zeynep starts her MSc in January and is worried about juggling it with Kemal and work. Deepa offered to do school pickups on Tuesdays. Deepa's mum is out of hospital and doing much better. Need to send Zeynep the reading list link I promised.

spans.text: send Zeynep the reading list link
